messages:
maria: Observability alert: ap-southeast-3 is showing sustained downstream conn throttles to GPU pools. Model inference p90 latency -> 2.1s, error rate 504s increasing. Repro: several KV cache ops timing out.
liam: Seeing similar from infra logs. egress TCP RST spike to provider ASN. Net team said provider admitted shaping on port 443 in that colo.
chen: Are control plane heartbeats ok? ETA on provider fix?
maria: Heartbeats mostly ok but kube-probes flapping on a subset of nodes. Provider hasn't given ETA.
nate: We should shift traffic off that region before it causes broader queue backing. Propose staged GSLB weight shift: ap-southeast-3 -> 0 over 6m, split to ap-northeast-2 and eu-central-1.
aisha: +1. Keep small canary first: 20% for 3m, then 50%, then 100% of affected host pools. Need to reduce batch sizes in ap-northeast to avoid burst.
julia: Adding runbook steps: update GSLB weights, verify health-check success, reduce per-request batch to 1 for the receiving pools for 10m.
traffic-bot: /gslb plan --from ap-southeast-3 --to ap-northeast-2:60,eu-central-1:40 --stages 20,50,100 --stage-interval 3m
maria: Executing plan now. I will watch token-level latency and queue depth.
liam: Noted. Also pre-warm KV cache on ap-northeast-2 by running vip-hotload job.
chen: Oncall FYI: nodes in ap-southeast-3 showing nvlink error counters bumping. Likely a rack-level switch issue causing asymmetric egress.
oncall-bot: oncall alert acknowledged by aisha. Response window 30m.
aisha: I'm here, will watch SLO dashboards and advise rollback if p95 > 3s or error rate > 2% sustained.
maria: Stage 1 applied: ap-southeast-3 -> 80, ap-northeast-2 -> 10, eu-central-1 -> 10. Monitoring.
liam: I see traffic moving. No errors yet in ap-northeast-2 after hotload.
chen: KV tail latency lowered in eu-central-1 too. Good.
maria: Stage 2 applied: ap-southeast-3 -> 50, ap-northeast-2 -> 30, eu-central-1 -> 20.
nate: Reminder: lower batch_size override pushed to ap-northeast-2 API pods: `BATCH_SIZE=1` (rolling restart).
julia: health-checks steady. No provider update yet. Recommend keeping weights at stage 3 for 15m before fully draining.
maria: Stage 3 applied: ap-southeast-3 -> 0, ap-northeast-2 -> 60, eu-central-1 -> 40. ap-southeast-3 pool marked draining.
liam: Evac complete. Marking infra incident and tagging billing for cross-region egress spike.
chen: Filing follow-up ticket with provider and networking for cross-tenant shaping claim.
aisha: We'll keep ap-southeast-3 in 'maintenance' until provider confirms. Reopen if errors reappear.
maria: Thanks all. I'll post summary to #incidents and send a note to customer-success for impacted customers.
traffic-bot: /gslb commit --ticket INF-8342 --summary "Evacuated ap-southeast-3 due to provider egress shaping; traffic redistributed to ap-northeast-2 and eu-central-1"
